title.narrative: Europe-China School of Law

description.narrative: The action will create the Europe-China School of Law (ECSL) offering high-level legal education to law students and legal professionals and conducting Sino-European legal research and consultancy activities. It is ECSL's overall goal to substantially contribute to the advancement of the rule of law in China and to significantly improve the expertise of Chinese legal practitioners and lawmakers with regard to their legal knowledge as well as skills and practical competences.
